title: Signal: Apache .htaccess file served as a response
scope: One response body containing Apache per-directory configuration directives.
limitations: One response body. The check reads directive lines; it does not apply the rules or test whether they would be enforced.

observation.body:
RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule ^admin/(.*)$ /internal/admin/$1 [L]
AuthType Basic
AuthUserFile /var/www/.htpasswd
Require valid-user

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
Options -Indexes
RewriteRule ^config/(.*)$ /blocked [R=403,L]
</IfModule>
Order deny,allow
Deny from all
Enable pretty URLs with RewriteEngine On in your server configuration.

fpNotes: A page that quotes a single directive inside a code block is not reported, because the rule needs two directive lines at line starts. An nginx configuration served the same way is covered by its own shape.
